title: Follow the logic of a short text
instructions: Read the whole text, then choose the pair of words for both gaps.

parts.prompt: Mira had practised her speech for weeks. ___, she felt nervous when she saw the crowd. She took a slow breath, ___ her voice grew steadier.

choice_rationales.A: Even so shows the surprise after weeks of practice, and and adds what happened next.
choice_rationales.B: Practice would not be expected to cause nerves, and but wrongly treats the steadier voice as a surprise.
choice_rationales.C: Her nerves are not an example of practice, and unless sets a condition the text does not contain.
choice_rationales.D: Her nerves are not an extra point of the same kind, and although reverses the helpful link.

parts.hint: Check each gap against the sentence around it.
parts.correct_explanation: Being nervous after long practice is a surprise, and the steadier voice follows the breath.
